name: CTI Response
summary: Roll-off boxes for Bryan, College Station, and nearby towns including Hearne, Franklin, Navasota, Brenham, Caldwell, Madisonville, and Hempstead. The page lists sizes and same-day delivery. It does not list a price.
prohibited: Hazardous materials. The page says to call about special waste before loading.
